title: GuidanceParams
description: Forward-guidance params: stance multipliers on the expectations re-anchoring pull (SPEC-GUIDE-1), plus the rate-move tolerance below which a decision does not surprise markets (SPEC-GUIDE-2).

hawkish_multiplier.description: Re-anchoring-pull multiplier when the Chair adopts a hawkish forward-guidance stance.

neutral_multiplier.description: Re-anchoring-pull multiplier when the Chair adopts a neutral forward-guidance stance.

dovish_multiplier.description: Re-anchoring-pull multiplier when the Chair adopts a dovish forward-guidance stance.

surprise_tolerance.description: Rate move (decimal, e.g. 0.0025 = 25bp) within which a decision is consistent with guidance and does not surprise markets. Must be > 0 — a zero tolerance would make every non-hold decision surprise markets, inverting the intent.
